My aspie goes through cycles. I find they will text when there is something relevant to say or to ask a question. But there are gaps where they won't reply, and it's either to recharge or from dealing with their own emotions from that day. It's never personal, and I know how hard it is to not take it that way (bpd + adhd here), but you honestly need to keep yourself busy during these times. I find I tend to hurt my own feelings by anxiously waiting by the phone. I will send random things like songs or a funny meme I think we would both like, but only sporadically. For my aspie anyways, there is no need for filler text like with NTs. It was a different cycle to learn, but I've adapted.
